title: SWF: Export complete document as downloadable SWF
description: Add a compile-and-download function in packages/swf/src/index.ts: exportSWF(doc, options?) returns Uint8Array. This is a convenience wrapper that calls compile(doc, options) and returns the bytes. Also add triggerDownload(bytes: Uint8Array, filename: string) that creates a blob URL and clicks an anchor. Tests: exportSWF returns non-empty Uint8Array starting with 'FWS' or 'CWS'.
